notes: Posted objective 'Just Bring It/Layeth the Smacketh Down' is a joke name for Bring Him Before Me / Take Your Father's Place (description: 'BHBM style'; starts DS2 Throne Room, Your Destiny, Insignificant Rebellion).

Start section as posted: objective, Death Star II: Throne Room, Your Destiny, Insignificant Rebellion, Oppressive Enforcement, Mobilization Points, Imperial Arrest Order, Prepared Defenses; several Effects start, so no single starting Effect is set. Oppressive Enforcement is the Special Edition Effect (no Defensive Shields in August 2000).
The list as posted totals 59; the strategy update says 'Theres also one more card in there....... Were in Attack Position', so We're In Attack Position Now was added (total 60).

Posted 'Endor Docking Bay' dested Endor: Landing Platform (Docking Bay); 'Spaceport Docking Bay' the Dark Special Edition site; 'Dreadnuaghts' Dreadnaught-Class Heavy Cruiser; 'Mara Jade, The Emporers Slave' Mara Jade, The Emperor's Hand (2 copies of a unique character as posted); 'Id Just As Soon Kiss the Wookiee' I'd Just As Soon Kiss A Wookiee.
'Grabber x2' matches no card in the August 2000 pool: kept as posted (UNKNOWN).
The update says he took out I'd Just As Soon Kiss A Wookiee for Emperor's Power; the list still shows IJASKAW, dested as posted.
